blog_title: How to Check T-Shirt GSM at Home — 220 GSM vs 160 GSM Fraud Exposed for Bulk Buyers
caption:
₹2 lakh in dead stock. One manufacturer jumped from t-shirts to joggers without testing. 😬

Jogger sizing kills brands: waist, length, ankle must match perfectly. One wrong size = full rejection. Fleece behaves different from terry. Different from interlock.

T-shirt S-M-L is easy. Joggers? Start with 50 pieces, 3 sizes, 2 fabrics. Test first. Save the ₹2 lakh.

Save this post before your next bulk order 👇
